name: rebalance_outside_band_partial
description: Drifted weight is outside the band, so trade partial_ratio*d, not the full gap. absolute_band_nav=0.02 and partial_ratio=0.5 are explicit illustrative synthetic values (PENDING in the monograph); band_relative=0.25 is the registry example.
derivation: equity=10000; AAA mult=1 mark=100, position 10. w_cur=10*100/10000=0.10. target=0.20 -> d=0.10. threshold=max(0.25*0.20, 0.02)=max(0.05, 0.02)=0.05. abs(d)=0.10 >= 0.05 -> trade. trade_weight=partial_ratio*d=0.5*0.10=0.05. qty=0.05*10000/(1*100)=5.0 contracts; step 1 -> 5; notional=5*1*100=500 >= min_notional 1 -> trade. orders={'AAA': +5.0}. Full d would be 0.10 -> 10 contracts; partial ratio pins the 5.
